info.name: Coveo Activity Activities Source Item Types API

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3`

params.name: sourceId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [source](https://docs.coveo.com/en/246/).
**Example:** `mycoveocloudv2organizationg8tp8wu3-gravodalyysjsu34camnvxm2d2y`

items.docs:
Lists all available [item](https://docs.coveo.com/en/210/) types in a [source](https://docs.coveo.com/en/246/).
**Required privilege:** Sources - View

Privilege required ``` {"owner":"PLATFORM","targetDomain":"SOURCE","type":"VIEW","targetId":"*"} ```
